'''Usnia''' was a [[Forest/Legends|forested]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Usnia system/Legends|Usnia system]] of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was also situated close to [[the Tangles]], an area of intersecting [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]. Usnia was connected via [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes to the [[Dornean system|Dornean]], [[Tranthellix system/Legends|Trenthellix]], and [[Varadan system/Legends|Varadan systems]]. It was declared a nature reserve by [[House Petro]], one of the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]] of the Senex-Juvex region.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
Usnia was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-18.<ref name="Atlas" />
